query:
SELECT COUNT(*) as total, 
       COUNT(CASE WHEN entry_type = 'article' THEN 1 END) as articles,
       COUNT(CASE WHEN entry_type = 'misc' THEN 1 END) as misc
FROM bibliography_entries;
